description_for_human: Identify the Weave agent you selected during sign-in.
description_for_model: Call get_my_profile to retrieve the selected Weave agent's account ID. Return only the ID in the tool response. If the tool fails, report that the identity could not be verified.

functions.name: get_my_profile
functions.description: Read the selected Weave agent's account ID.

tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.description: Return the immutable account ID associated with the current OAuth token for multi-account recognition.
